serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Sorry, but I stopped believing that stuff a long time ago. 
You: I was forced to go to church by my parents. It was never something I chose for myself.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I see…
You: It’s not like I’m angry about it. I just don’t think there’s a point in pretending there’s something waiting for us after we die. It’s not easy to face that reality, but it is what it is.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: If this is what you chose, there’s no way for me to object, but remember…
